rules.title: Clock-domain inventory and sequential elements without an identified clock root
rules.notes: report unclassified flops

rules.title: Clock root that is not a primary input (logic-generated, gated through a black box, cyclic or undriven)
rules.notes: constrained confidence

rules.title: Asynchronous single-bit flop-to-flop crossing without recognized synchronization
rules.notes: primary error; candidate stages with opaque call effects remain unresolved

rules.title: Asynchronous multi-bit crossing without recognized safe protocol
rules.notes: primary error; candidate stages with opaque call effects remain unresolved

rules.title: Synchroniser shorter than the minimum depth
rules.notes: primitive/FF-chain aware; checks the configured minimum for both register-launched and primary-input crossings; candidate stages with opaque call effects remain unresolved

rules.title: Combinational logic between synchronizer stages
rules.notes: connectivity path check

rules.title: Synchroniser stage before the required depth feeds anything but the next stage
rules.notes: absorbs CDC-027

rules.title: Combinational, glitch-prone or unregistered source before synchronizer
rules.notes: heuristic; source stability assumed unless specified

rules.title: Individually synchronized bus bits / incoherent capture
rules.notes: avoid blanket exemption for 2FF-per-bit; candidate stages with opaque call effects remain unresolved

rules.title: Destination cone combines two or more asynchronous influences
rules.notes: absorbs CDC-011 and CDC-036; register cones plus declared-clock, bit-accurate observable output reconvergence; output correlation/glitch tolerance remains Unresolved; evidence: reconvergence_kind same-domain | multi-domain | unsynchronised | unresolved-source

rules.title: Missing/incorrect synchronization attributes or recognized primitive metadata
rules.notes: technology profile dependent
rules.gap: checks RTL synchronizer attributes only; recognized primitive metadata and technology profile bundles are not checked. Excludes a delayed-copy follower only when an exact detector is established and the follower has no other data, clock or asynchronous-control use or continuation as a synchronizer stage; ambiguous and mixed followers remain counted

rules.title: Pulse may be shorter than the destination capture window
rules.notes: absorbs CDC-042 (computed event-like signals); explicit boundary_events contracts bind exact primary-input bits to SDC launch clocks and compare finite duration against internal destination sampling even without output delay; admits only a model-proven ordinary active-low async-reset released-source branch for direct sampling, comparing only during deassertion; required delivery with unresolved reset timing, conflicting clock/data/mode roles, and unsupported control/source behavior remain Unresolved; defers recognized register handshakes to CDC-024

rules.title: Exact adjacent-stage toggle detector structure and observation
rules.notes: structural template; detector requires exact adjacent post-first stage operands, surviving full writes, one detector branch pair and optional simple reset with proved asserted and inactive arms; rejects call qualifiers and follows combinational stage influence; supports registered comparisons, positive conjunction qualification and exact constant packed-bit selects; excludes proved monotonic state and request/ack handshake legs, reports unresolved event intent without a detector, and checks detector depth, exact output observation, compatible stage edges, and modeled asynchronous reset values

rules.title: Handshake request/acknowledge structural mismatch
rules.notes: structural only; exact source-flop dependencies cross elaborated hierarchy; a unique reciprocal pair gets CDC-024, a one-way dependency warns, and ambiguous ownership remains Unresolved without suppressing CDC-013/014; CDC-015.reach_budget lowers the bounded-search budget for fixtures; NOT protocol proof

rules.title: Grouped unsynchronized multi-bit payload capture unqualified by same-instance synchronized control
rules.notes: structural data-hold policy; decomposes non-hold local/feedback mux arms, expands bounded combinational next-state drivers, and requires bundle-level qualifier coherence

rules.title: Async FIFO Gray pointer sync chain or pointer crossing issue
rules.notes: Recognizes Gray conversion and incomplete pointer synchronizer chains. Exact full-width lane sets can cross module ports and one varying generate index with other indices fixed. Destination first-stage constant overrides require exact normal D, trusted destination-local or accepted local-reset guards, and identical guard sets across affected Gray siblings. Procedural case arms are considered together even when the selector is constant. Gray syntax does not establish one-step updates or FIFO safety.

rules.title: Recognized Gray crossing with unestablished direct unit-step transition, destination chain integrity, or datapath max-delay bound
rules.notes: Accepts explicit-unit (for both clock period and delay), edge-unqualified complete datapath max-delay endpoint coverage (excluding -reset_path and -hold) bounded by the active source period using declared RTL bit indices. Requires matching synchronous/asynchronous resets, capture clock edges, and clean synchroniser chains across all destination Gray siblings.

rules.title: Clock multiplexer or combiner not recognised as glitch-free
rules.notes: Also checks clock-named top-level output muxes without register consumers; select intent remains unresolved. Self-inverting divided-clock operands are identified structurally, without inferring phase.

rules.title: Clock-gate enable launched in another clock domain
rules.notes: split: gating without an enable latch is CDC-045; black-box gating is CDC-002; divided operands use their source clock only for domain comparison; gate and enable site evidence does not change finding identity

rules.title: Register captures a value that may be driven by an unmodelled black box
rules.notes: report as unresolved unless modeled; capture register is available as typed site_signal evidence for strict attribution only

rules.title: Protocol functional-correctness obligation for a recognised FIFO, handshake or toggle structure
rules.notes: Structural protocol candidates retain explicit functional proof obligations; unique reciprocal handshake endpoints may cross elaborated hierarchy; ambiguous pairing is Unresolved and a generic obligation is not defect detection; pattern recognition is not a safety proof.

rules.title: Reset-source inventory and registers without an identified reset root
rules.notes: required foundation

rules.title: Reset input with no constraint (unknown reset source)
rules.notes: incomplete coverage

rules.title: Asynchronous reset deassertion not synchronized to receiving clock
rules.notes: handle exceptions explicitly

rules.title: Data crosses between different reset domains on the same clock
rules.notes: central RDC use case

rules.title: Data crosses between independently reset domains on different clocks
rules.notes: classify overlap with CDC

rules.title: Reset synchronizer has too few stages or logic between stages
rules.notes: recognize patterns and assumptions

rules.title: Reset generated by a register or logic in another clock/reset domain
rules.notes: async assertion vs deassertion

rules.title: Reset net combined from two or more reset sources
rules.notes: graph-based

rules.title: Reset gating/muxing that may glitch
rules.notes: physical glitch proof excluded

rules.title: Unreset register feeding a reset register of the same module instance
rules.notes: context-aware heuristic

rules.title: Several independent asynchronous reset sources: sequencing not modelled
rules.notes: explicit incomplete status, not presumed safe

rules.title: Power intent not supplied: retention and isolation resets are not evaluated
rules.notes: Power-intent-related reset crossing analysis when power-domain information is supplied; label missing power intent unknown rather than safe.

rules.title: Recovery, removal and minimum pulse width obligation for every asynchronous reset
rules.notes: Report recovery/removal/pulse-width proof obligations; physical safety needs library/timing data, so absence of that information is not evidence of safety.

rules.title: Model-derived register clock and reset classification
Clock source, generated-clock master/source, and non-clock path-exception object resolution
Clock redeclaration overrides, asynchronous root aliases, and generated-clock group conflicts
Crossings and primary-input captures with unknown clock relationship flagged as unresolved
Unmodeled black-box instance inventory
rules.notes: Inventories unmodeled boxes by module, with counts and up to eight site locations. Fully modeled library instances and encrypted-module identification are outside this predicate.

rules.title: Waivers are well-formed with exact catalog rule ID, non-placeholder owner, and reason
Every recognized synchronizer/CDC primitive has an explicit, documented trust model
Timing-cut and false-path exceptions do not imply CDC safety
SDC subset support and unsupported Tcl commands are disclosed
Model connectivity, clock, reset, and pragma precision fallbacks disclosed in coverage

rules.gap: only scalar enum selectors linked through direct same-enum value sources to clocked state are analyzed; array/dynamic selectors and indirect or opaque alias relationships are not fully inventoried

flags every plain 'always' block in user sources and suggests a replacement from its sensitivity list; library units (-v/-y) are not checked, misuse of always_comb/always_ff/always_latch is not checked (a separate semantic concern), and an always_latch choice for an intentional latch needs review

rules.title: Synchronizer stage clock/reset mismatch
rules.notes: Register-launched and primary-input chains compare required clock edges and asynchronous reset sources with effective polarity; exact inverted reset aliases normalize together. Primary-input mismatches prevent CDC-029 clean containment and qualifier evidence.

rules.title: Unsafe or clock-unresolved clock-enabled CDC capture in modeled writes
rules.notes: Require one synchronized qualifier and polarity across all source-specific data-moving writes and across a multi-bit bundle; decompose non-hold mux arms and staged combinational next-state logic while retaining bypass and complementary-arm hazards.

rules.title: Asynchronous top-level input without CDC contract
rules.notes: Checks register captures per precise input-to-D dependency and primary-input feed-throughs under output-delay clock contracts; explicit asynchronous unsafe capture is ERROR Established, while opaque/approximate sibling captures retain separate unresolved findings. Same-source payload qualification requires complete effective launch contracts for every active mode. Only a direct feedback data arm is a self-hold; CDC-039 identifies each qualified or unresolved capture endpoint separately.

rules.title: create_generated_clock relationship assumed by constraints, not derived from the design
rules.notes: Avoid classifying frequency-related clocks as safely synchronous without constraints.

rules.title: Clock multiplexer select not synchronous to the clocks it switches
rules.notes: Model known glitchless primitives; report unknown topology and dynamic select.

rules.title: Data/control bundle coherence after synchronization
rules.notes: Checks modeled source-bit dependencies across separately instantiated chains for depth skew; protocol association semantics remain outside the structural depth predicate.

rules.title: Gray pointer pair with missing or unresolved asynchronous reset on a pointer or fan-in register
rules.notes: Requires complete all-bit mutual coupling and a unique partner before reporting a structural FIFO candidate, and checks per-bit effective constant asynchronous reset writes across pointer and fan-in registers. One-way, partial, ambiguous or search-limited coupling keeps CDC-024/RDC-023 Unresolved and reports a missing or unresolved pointer reset under CDC-034 Unresolved. Unrelated directions do not pair.

rules.title: Memory written and read in different clock domains
rules.notes: Unpacked-array memories and library RAMs; empty ports do not erase RAM clock evidence, unknown clock relations remain unresolved through clean chains, and independent per-bit read chains retain bus-coherence review. Write-enable qualification requires a scalar identifier that directly names or exactly aliases the synchronizer output. Coherence is checked within each read port.

rules.title: Clock group relationship contradiction with observed synchronizers
rules.notes: Checks named relationships against modeled structure. Two asynchronous SDC aliases of a single RTL root can remain undisclosed.

rules.title: Multi-cycle/falsely cut paths do not establish CDC safety
rules.notes: Tracks exact bit endpoints and preserves false-path/multicycle versus max/min-delay behavior. Regexp selectors are not interpreted; runs that contain them disclose constraint analysis as INCOMPLETE.

rules.title: Synchronized payload qualifier evidence and unresolved capture stability
rules.notes: Require the same synchronized qualifier and polarity across every source-specific data-moving write and across all bits of a multi-bit bundle; supports non-hold local/processed-feedback mux arms and bounded staged combinational next-state logic while retaining source-stability/protocol obligations.

rules.title: Synchroniser recognised from an annotation or a library description
rules.notes: Report missing or contradictory library annotations.

rules.title: Reset-dependent CDC protocol activation / release
rules.notes: Uses effective assertion polarity for exact inverted reset aliases and compares actual modeled source/capture bit pairs; reset values, sequencing and release timing remain obligations.

rules.title: Mixed positive/negative edge domains
rules.notes: Model edge relationship and relevant metastability boundaries.

rules.title: Serial or event review evidence from adjacent synchronizer stages or exact output taps
rules.notes: review-only evidence; no protocol conclusion

rules.title: Clock gated by logic without a recognised enable latch
rules.notes: split from CDC-020; RTL latch proof requires same elaborated clock identity and positive AND polarity; hierarchy/port transfers not represented as aliases can remain conservative warnings; library clock_gate cells declare enable_latched; modeled gate roots and library instance/output sites have typed attribution evidence

rules.title: Black-box input fed from another clock domain
rules.notes: split from CDC-023; library blackbox cells declare port directions and clock roles

rules.title: Launch bit synchronised more than once into one clock domain
rules.notes: AMD CDC-11: covers register-launched and primary-input bits, including distinct packed destination captures; considers every matching input-delay launch contract.

rules.title: Asynchronous reset driven by a data register that is not a reset synchroniser
rules.notes: Report structural hazards plus proof obligations requiring timing information.

rules.title: Reset synchronizer stage fanout to logic
rules.notes: Identify use of intermediate reset synchronizer stages.

rules.title: Reset mux/gate select from different reset domain
rules.notes: Follow asynchronously changing select controls and reset outputs.

rules.title: Asynchronous reset signal also used as functional data
rules.notes: Differentiate reset semantics from general clock crossing.

rules.title: Partial reset of packed state and dependent control
rules.notes: Find unstable unreset bits influencing reset-visible behavior.

rules.title: FIFO and handshake reset release sequencing
rules.notes: Check reset-domain coordination / unknown protocol obligations; reciprocal, ambiguous, and search-incomplete handshake candidates retain an independently gated Unresolved reset obligation, and toggle detectors verify reset compatibility across the source, all required synchronizer stages, and detected delayed stages.

rules.title: Reset request/acknowledge sequencing across domains
rules.notes: Static recognition and explicit unresolved functional obligations.

rules.title: Primary output that depends on a register without reset
rules.notes: Detect uncontrolled outputs and reset isolation assumptions.

rules.title: Several asynchronous controls on one register (set and reset, power-on and functional)
rules.notes: Check priority and behavior if both assert/deassert independently.

rules.title: Reset-domain false-path exception does not imply safety
rules.notes: Record RDC crossing despite timing cuts.

rules.title: One reset used with both polarities, or a reset that is the inverted copy of its source
rules.notes: Validate propagated reset aliases, inversions, and synchronizer output use.

rules.deck_exclusion: needs a UPF or CPF input, which 1.0 does not define; RDC-012 reports the missing model
rules.title: Retention or isolation reset boundaries when power intent provided
rules.notes: Handle active power intents and missing modeling explicitly.
rules.gap: needs a power-intent (UPF/CPF) input, which is not supported; RDC-012 reports the missing model

rules.title: Reset synchroniser stages without consistent synchronisation attributes
rules.notes: Same attribute policy as CDC-012; AMD CDC-8.

rules.title: Clock constraint and captured data-input delay coverage
rules.notes: All clocks including generated/muxed roots covered or unresolved.

rules.title: Top-level output-boundary CDC contracts and uncontracted CDC-relevant outputs
rules.notes: A supplied output-delay contract is checked; bit-accurate word intent is Unresolved and does not call pure concatenation reconvergence. Single-domain non-synchronized outputs without an output delay stay uncontracted; uncontracted CDC-relevant outputs and omitted bits report WARNING Unresolved and constraints INCOMPLETE. Input-side primary-input captures are partly covered by CDC-029, not a complete CST-012 contract inventory.

rules.title: Generated clock source and bounded RTL derivation consistency
rules.notes: Checks exact RTL aliases, inversion, and provable fixed 2^k toggle-flop integer dividers; multiplication, phase, mux/bypass, and unprovable derivations stay Unresolved and INCOMPLETE.

rules.title: Applied case-analysis fixed mode values and unanalysed alternatives disclosure
rules.notes: Discloses applied case constants and unanalysed alternatives.

rules.title: Multi-configuration parameter/generate completeness
rules.notes: Coverage matrix across representative compile manifests.

rules.title: Declared reset-state and reset-sequence assumptions are bound, reported and, where the RTL can show it, structurally checked
rules.notes: Classify unmodeled reset phase conditions as unresolved.

rules.title: Blackbox boundary protocol and reset metadata quality
rules.notes: Track missing blackbox contract, model scope and location.

rules.title: Constraint parser problems, unreadable files, and invalid delay or reference declarations
rules.notes: Source report every skipped unsupported directive or expression.

rules.title: Rule execution and enablement accounting for catalogued checks
rules.notes: All registered checks accounted for by active profile and exceptions.

rules.title: Crossing inventory consistency and report completeness
rules.notes: Every crossing classified unsafe, safe-with-evidence, waived or unresolved.

rules.title: Constraint source provenance and conflict trace
rules.notes: Provide file/line and origin of all clock/reset classifications.
